Appendix K
Reproducibility and Final Upgrade Archive
This appendix documents the nal archive. It is written so that an examiner
or a future researcher can reproduce the model-based results without reconstructing
the project from memory. The archive is self-contained: the de-identied measured
matrix, derived qualitative features, pipeline, R scripts, generated outputs, gures,
and Colab notebooks are included. Identiable participant-observation material is
kept in a restricted folder and is not required to reproduce the reported results; the
pipeline falls back to aggregate qualitative features when the restricted le is absent.

K.2
Exact Reproduction Commands
The nal pipeline is deterministic given its seed.
The reported run used seed
20261105, n = 500 personas, and 18 sessions.
Local (Windows PowerShell).
python 02_code/pipeline/loklok_pipeline_v8.py `
--root . --n-personas 500 --sessions 18 --seed 20261105 `
--embedding-model BAAI/bge-m3 --device cpu
python 02_code/pipeline/generate_figures.py --root .
pdflatex -interaction=nonstopmode thesis_final.tex
(three passes)
Local (Linux/macOS or Colab).
python 02_code/pipeline/loklok_pipeline_v8.py \
--root . --n-personas 500 --sessions 18 --seed 20261105 \
--embedding-model BAAI/bge-m3 --device cuda
python 02_code/pipeline/generate_figures.py --root .
R reproduction.
The R scripts reproduce the measured-wave psychometrics, the
CFA with lavaan, the factorial summaries, and the Bayesian cross-check. The R
path is optional for the Python pipeline but is included for audit:

K.5
Defense Questions Specic to the Upgrade
You generated 500 personas. Isn't that a fake sample?
The personas are a computational population drawn from a debiased prior
anchored in the 52 measured records. They are not presented as additional
respondents. The 23 design is within-persona, so the contrast is paired by
construction; the model's uncertainty is reported separately from sampling
uncertainty in the eld wave.

APPENDIX K. REPRODUCIBILITY AND FINAL UPGRADE ARCHIVE
311
Why should I believe the narrow intervals?
You should not read them as human population intervals. They are repeated-
sampling intervals across generated personas in a deterministic model. The
thesis says this explicitly and reports the measured-wave uncertainty sepa-
rately.
The Hamiltonian did not decrease. Does that falsify EST-P2?
It falsies the strong claim that this particular operationalisation must min-
imise the diagnostic. The thesis reports the sign honestly and treats the Hamil-
tonian as a specication device. The diversity and echo results still support
the conditional mechanism, but the thermodynamic language is not promoted
to a law.
Why is the skeptical prior result so dierent?
Because a prior with standard deviation 0.15 is extremely skeptical about an
eect of about one rating point. The thesis reports the full prior sensitivity
rather than selecting the most favourable prior. The moderate skeptical prior
still yields a positive interval; the extreme prior is a stress test.
What is genuinely new in the upgrade?
The integrated, reproducible pipeline: four-stream embedding, DML/IPW de-
biasing, spectral manifold, within-persona 23 tensor ABM, eight lters, Zewail-
inspired attention gate, GRM-IRT measurement, dual inference, adversarial
misinformation tests, Sobol sensitivity, and a complete archive. The individ-
ual components are borrowed; the integration and the explicit claim ceilings
are the contribution.

APPENDIX K. REPRODUCIBILITY AND FINAL UPGRADE ARCHIVE
312
Why include the Arabic front matter and the Zewail analogy?
The Arabic title page and abstract meet the ACU/SCU front-matter require-
ment. The Zewail analogy gives the attentional gate a precise, falsiable time-
resolved form. It is labelled as a formal analogy, not as a claim that social
listening is chemistry.
K.6
Final Quality Gate
1. Every major claim identies its evidence tier (measured, model-based, theo-
retical, or future empirical).
2. Measured and simulated results are never merged into one table without a
label.
3. All causal language about G0/G1 is conditional on the model.
4. The measured N = 52 matrix is not altered to improve signicance.
5. The synthetic NMLS prole is not presented as human media literacy.
6. The Hamiltonian is not presented as a physical law.
7. The BRS is not presented as a validated consequential ranking.
8. The skeptical-prior result is reported, not hidden.
9. The archive contains the code, data, seeds, outputs, gures, R scripts, and
Colab notebooks needed to reproduce the model-based results.
10. The Arabic front matter is included and the English abstract remains the
primary abstract.
